sources.title: Final Budget Day post-minutes — December 16, 2025
sources.locator: Item 11, Final Passing of the Main Budget Motion
sources.exactExcerpt:
11. Final Passing of the Main Budget Motion
Moved by P. Wolf
Seconded by C. James
That the Regional Municipality of Waterloo take the following action with respect to the 2026 Plan and Budget, as amended:
Approve the 2026 Operating Budget as summarized in Appendix C of report COR-CFN-25-027 dated December 16, 2025 and as amended by Budget Committee on December 16, 2025, with a net expenditure of $1,801,533,210 and a property tax levy of $887,328,641 in 2026;
Approve the 2026 Capital Budget and 2027-2035 Capital Forecast as summarized in Appendix C of report COR-CFN-25-027 dated December 16, 2025, and as amended by Budget Committee on December 16, 2025 and subject to final adjustments for 2025 project carry-forwards.
Carried (11 to 4)

sources.title: O. Reg. 400/98: Tax Matters — Rates for School Purposes
sources.locator: Residential Property, s. 1 (1); consolidation effective January 1, 2026; last amendment O. Reg. 297/25
sources.exactExcerpt: 1. (1) For 2026, the tax rate for school purposes for residential property is prescribed as 0.153 per cent of the assessed value of the property.

sources.title: O. Reg. 297/25: Amending O. Reg. 400/98
sources.exactExcerpt:
Made: November 27, 2025
Filed: December 5, 2025
Published on e-Laws: December 5, 2025
1. Ontario Regulation 400/98 is amended by striking out “2025” wherever it appears and substituting in each case “2026”.
2. This Regulation comes into force on the later of January 1, 2026 and the day this Regulation is filed.
